reviewLighting.description: Shared neutral inspection key; review pass only. No production source or material change.

gait.progress: Distance-driven 12-frame walk inherited from last-light-gait. Review idle is phase zero; full production settle/action/idle states are not claimed.

materialEncoding.rgba: Production fallback self-light only; no outside-alpha bloom.
materialEncoding.normal: RGB world-space normal encoded from [-1,1] to [0,255]; A opaque coverage.
materialEncoding.material: R roughness, G specular, B AO, A emission/2 (not coverage).
materialEncoding.depth: RG uint16 big-endian, decode value/256-80. B=4, A opaque coverage. Depth is relative to actor origin.
materialEncoding.contact: Black RGB / soft local contact alpha; directional shadows require pose geometry.

mount.collision: Retain existing gameplay collider; never infer from image bounds.
mount.presentation: Use externalPresentation anchor. Legacy 32px weaponRig is not compatible and is not included.
mount.productionCoverage: Idle phase zero and twelve walk samples × eight world yaws only; no attack/hurt/death/settle integration.

sourceCompatibility: The optional rightArmPose author hook leaves all 104 default A body frames byte-identical; production export-receipt records the four G-buffer checks. Existing candidate images are unchanged.
